title: electromechanical and hydraulic drives

specimens.name: Compact foot-mounted industrial electric motor
specimens.description: Ribbed TEFC-style metal housing, shaft, mounting feet and terminal box; no cable attached and no surrounding machine.

specimens.name: Standardized motor-and-helical-gearbox package
specimens.description: Compact electric motor joined to an inline cast gearbox with repeatable flange or feet and one output shaft; no external machine.

specimens.name: Hydraulic cylinder
specimens.description: Painted industrial cylinder with polished rod, clevis ends and two clearly visible hose ports; no hoses attached.

specimens.name: Compact hydraulic rotary actuator
specimens.description: Cast body with standardized mounting flange and keyed output shaft; no hoses and no larger mechanism.

specimens.name: Guarded V-belt drive fragment
specimens.description: Two pulleys and one V-belt behind a removable formed-sheet safety cover that closes the entire front/outer face of the transmission; only small ventilation slots or a narrow inspection opening may expose limited belt area, never both pulleys or the full belt path; no motor or machine.

specimens.name: Guarded roller-chain drive fragment
specimens.description: Two sprockets and one chain behind a removable formed-metal safety cover that closes the entire front/outer face of the transmission; only small ventilation slots or a narrow inspection opening may expose limited chain area, never both sprockets or the full chain loop; no external machine.

specimens.name: Industrial linear solenoid actuator
specimens.description: Metal coil housing, straight plunger and mounting flange; no wiring.

specimens.name: Electromagnetic clutch/brake module
specimens.description: Compact clutch/brake module centered on the shaft line: short axial drum/disc housing with two shaft hubs and a removable service cover; silhouette must be visibly shorter and flatter than an electric motor, with no cooling fins, fan shroud, terminal box, lifting eye or motor-style feet; no surrounding drivetrain.

global_forbidden: open-front belt or chain display/cutaway guards
motor-like clutch/brake housings with cooling fins, fan shrouds, terminal boxes, lifting eyes or motor-style feet
baked cast shadows or contact shadows
glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX

era_contract.character: industrial assistance through standardized electric and hydraulic actuation, guarded dangerous drives and repeatable cast/formed housings
